title: The Borrowed Witness
author: Marguerite Vane
blurb: Cyrus Thackeray, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
